name: Egeneonu Odinakachi A.J
title: Data Analyst
headline: I turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
intro: I clean, model and analyse business data in Excel, SQL and Power BI, then explain what it means in plain language. I work best on problems in finance, fintech, supply chain and tech.
availability: Open to remote roles and freelance projects
location: Imo, Nigeria. Available to work remotely.
about: I came into data analytics through a love of problem-solving. I like taking a messy spreadsheet, finding what is actually going on, and turning it into something a manager can act on the same day.

I studied Project Management Technology at the Federal University of Technology Owerri (FUTO), graduating in 2025, and I have a background in IT. Project management taught me to start every analysis by scoping the real question, agreeing on what success looks like, and delivering on time.
My work so far spans retail sales, banking transactions, customer retention and public health research. I am currently learning Python and working towards my first professional certification.
education: B.Tech, Project Management Technology — Federal University of Technology Owerri (FUTO), 2025

process.title: Understand the question

process.text: Model the data, test what matters and build dashboards people can read at a glance.

process.title: Recommend actions
process.text: Turn findings into clear, practical next steps for the business.
